statement: I computed AP@5 for targets A, B, C, D, E and predictions A, X, B, Y, C. Hits occur at ranks 1, 3 and 5, so AP@5 = (1 + 2/3 + 3/5)/5 = 34/75, approximately 0.4533. Randomly mixing past and future views would let the model learn behavior that was unavailable when making the recommendation. I therefore use earlier views for training and later views for validation. This is my metric/protocol check; I do not claim to have personally rerun all automated tests or re-derived the model implementations.
